title: Level 3 NVQ evidence framework
details: The 6570-05 Level 3 Trowel NVQ now uses Main Category > Sub-category > Activity > Evidence Method > mapped ACs
The full qualification is organised into 5 main categories, 20 sub-categories and 44 learner-facing activities with every official AC retained in the holistic mapping
Activities now offer the evidence method that genuinely fits: Photo plus text, guided Video, or guided Audio
Practical bricklaying activities keep visual workplace evidence and use staged evidence opportunities where needed
NVQ downloads now create one signed PDF evidence pack per main category plus sub-category/activity folders containing the original media
The existing Standards course flow, approved photo/video camera, photo speed, post-evidence OTJ connection and other Evia behaviour are unchanged
summary: Evia v150 rebuilds Level 3 Trowel NVQ evidence around a complete holistic activity framework without changing the Standards evidence flow.
